title: Cheluveye Ninne Nodalu
desc: Vishwa, a local tourist guide, falls deeply in love with Prakruthi. However, Prakruthi's parents forcibly arrange her marriage to a wealthy businessman.

title: Milana
desc: Anjali's father forces her to marry Akash. Unable to forget her past, she demands a divorce from Akash, but soon begins to fall for him.

title: Akhanda 2
desc: Renowned warrior Akhanda resurfaces to confront a dangerous tantric practitioner sowing chaos. However, he is not alone in his quest for peace as his twin brother Murali Krishna joins the fight.

title: Preethsu Thappenilla
desc: A happy-go-lucky man falls head over heels in love with a girl at first sight. By a twist of fate, they become victims of a tragic incident, which takes their relationship to the next level.

title: Bhroona
desc: Some of the villagers chance upon the temporary absence of a woman's husband and physically assault her, unbeknownst to the dire consequence that they would have to face.

title: Sidila Mari
desc: Ganganna and Ranga share a close bond with each other but an accident between them causes Ranga to lose his life. Years later, Ranga's son seeks out Ganganna in order to exact revenge.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Rayaru Bandaru Mavana Manege
desc: Suma and Vishnu act as a married couple to please her father. However, they get into trouble when her father finds out the truth.

title: Gandugali Kumara Rama
desc: Kumararama, son of King Deva Raya, is exiled by his stepmother. However, he strives to overcome the challenges that life throws at him.
